description: Department of Fiscal Policy - Casina Business (Regulation) Act, No. 17 of 2010
reasoning: This gazette notification amends existing casino business licensing regulations by repealing and replacing a schedule of fees. It is a regulatory action taken under the authority of the Casino Business (Regulation) Act, No. 17 of 2010. While it mentions Minister Ranil Wickremesinghe, this is only to establish the authority making the regulatory change, not to announce a personnel appointment or describe ministerial portfolios. The core content is purely regulatory - modifying financial requirements and criteria for casino licensing, which falls squarely under Legal/Regulatory matters.
